frames.inspected: All captures inspected with the Read tool via per-sentence contact sheets, a scene-edge sheet (first/last, all themes), phone sheets and zoomed face/gesture/net crops.

moderate: Scene 1 "A future grown small", sentences 1 and 3 (from the 8% scene-edge frame, ~1.8 s into sentence 1 and ~30% into sentence 3, all themes): the inheritor's "reflect" gesture lifts an open hand beside the head and, with the authored "tired" face (inward-slanted brows plus a slight smile), reads as a cheerful wave/sly grin during "our future has begun to look small" and the sober list of climate risk, war and concentrated power. It contradicts the plan's intrigue / sober-honesty cue. Use a quieter gesture (or none) and a visibly weary/sober face here; the wave-like rendering of "reflect" is a shared-rig issue to report separately. (The same raised hand for the builder at ~30% of scene 2 sentence 2 is more defensible and only minor.)

Scene 2 "Hope without prophecy", sentence 3 ("fellowship makes effort endurable", ~85%, all themes): the arriving teal companion (companion-b, authored "determined") renders as an angry scowl with a down-turned mouth, visible at playback size, contradicting the warm fellowship beat and "gathering energy" cue. Use happy/relieved/inspired for the arriving companion.
minor: Scene 2 sentence 1 (~50%): the teal bridge piece detaches from the builder's hand and floats ahead of her while she gestures "explain", then drops into its slot by itself.
Scene 2 sentence 3: the lever bar's left end overlaps the builder's right shoe (prop drawn over a person).

Scene 3 sentence 2-3: the safety net's vertical strands hang below the lower rope like a fringe and are drawn across the attempter's legs when he lands; the attempter leaps and returns to the column as a rigid standing figure floating diagonally through the air (no jump/climb pose).
Scene 3 sentence 2 (12-30%): the attempter fades in while the frontier tiles and labels are still fading out, briefly overlapping them as a ghost.
Scene 2 sentence 2 (~30%): builder's "reflect" raised hand also reads as a wave, though acceptable for an analytic question.

Builder (scene 2) and attempter (scene 3) share the blue coat + yellow scarf costume of different identities; at phone width they can read as the same person whose hair changed. Visual bible defines no actor roster.
Scene 1 sentence 4: the large globe crowds the helix and sits close to the risk row; busy composition.
At 393/320 px the "Unmapped mind", "Mostly night" and checklist labels become very small.

independentReviewHistory.notes: Every sentence has a fitting, source-grounded visual; no hidden key element, contradiction or obvious glitch found. Captions stay clear of artwork in all sampled frames; identities stable across Color/Light/Dark; Night variants legible. Verdict failed only on the two moderate expression/gesture mismatches.
